prompt.title: 通用约束（常驻，风格一致性）
prompt.rule: LINE. The character is drawn with a single, even, pure-black outline that runs unbroken around the whole silhouette - the hair, the face, the ears, the arms, the fingers, the clothes, the shoes and every accessory he carries. That outline keeps exactly the same thickness and the same pure black in every frame of the clip. It must never thin out, never break apart where a limb moves fast, and the flat colour inside it must never bleed over it or grow past it.

FLAT FILL. Every colour inside the outline stays a flat, unshaded, untextured field of exactly the same colour as the reference image. No gradient, no soft shading, no drop shadow, no cast shadow, no highlight, no rim light, no ambient occlusion, no dithering, no noise and no texture. Colour is filled in and left alone.

SAME CHARACTER. Every frame shows the identical character as the reference image: the same proportions, the same length of limb, the same size of head, the same hair shape, the same face, the same eyes, the same expression, the same clothes with the same number of visible details and the same accessories. He is never restyled, never redrawn, never aged, never slimmed, never made more or less detailed, and no detail is invented that is not in the reference image.

NOTHING ELSE. Nothing is added to the scene: no second character, no extra limb, no weapon or prop that the reference does not already show, no particle effect, no speed line, no motion blur, no impact frame, no dust, no spark, no text, no number, no logo and no watermark.
BACKDROP UNTOUCHED. The flat green background is left exactly as it is. The character never casts a shadow on it, never smears into it and never drags a trailing edge through it.
